title: Equestrian
dek: Rider gear, dressage pads, grooming tools and tack-room storage that riders and reviewers vouch for.

boards.title: In the saddle
boards.dek: Full-seat breeches, a zip tall boot, grip gloves and two MIPS helmets.

boards.title: Dressage squares
boards.dek: Two LeMieux pads, one with shimmable foam inserts.

boards.title: Grooming kit
boards.dek: A curry you wear and a soft finishing brush.

boards.title: Tack-room order
boards.dek: A spot for every saddle, bridle and brush.

items.name: PerforMAX All Season Full Seat Pull-On Breech
items.why: A pull-on full-seat breech with a segmented, perforated leather seat, a mesh panel at the stomach and two cargo pockets. Eventing Nation's reviewer found FITS' PerforMAX fabric comfortable and supportive in its compression, and noted it sheds hay and hair.

items.name: Heritage Contour II Field Zip Tall Riding Boot
items.why: A full-grain leather tall boot with a full-length YKK back zip, a Spanish-cut top and a removable cushioned insole. Your Horse's tester found the leather soft enough to need almost no breaking in, and after six months of riding the boots showed no wear. They are not insulated.
items.ebay: ariat heritage contour ii field zip

items.name: Roeck-Grip Riding Glove
items.why: A thin, stretchy close-contact glove for a direct feel of the rein. It works with touchscreens, comes in black, brown, grey and navy, and can be machine washed at 30°C.

items.name: ProSorb Dressage Square Pad
items.why: A dressage square with pockets for memory-foam inserts; it comes with two sets of four, at 9 mm and 13 mm, so you can shim the saddle's fit. It has a sweat-wicking lining and comes in black, white and navy.

items.name: Suede Classic Dressage Square Pad
items.why: A simpler LeMieux square: a suede top with high wither relief and a bamboo lining that wicks moisture. It goes in the washing machine at 30°C.

items.name: HandsOn Grooming Gloves
items.why: Gloves with rubber nodules on the fingers and palms that work like a curry wet or dry. Horse Nation's reviewer made them her go-to grooming tool, saying they reach the ears, jaw and belly better than a curry comb and beat a sponge at bath time.

items.name: Diva Exklusiv Brush
items.why: A German finishing brush with a lambskin core and a horsehair edge that lifts the last dust, made for sensitive horses. Your Horse's editor used a Haas set including the Diva Exclusive for five months and said it was all she needed besides a mane comb.

items.name: Easy-Up Wood Mounted Saddle Rack with Bridle Hook
items.why: A wall-mounted pine saddle rack with a beveled top to protect the leather and a bridle hook underneath, so one saddle and its bridle share a single spot. Mounting hardware is included.

items.name: Dura-Tech EZ-Store Hanging Grooming Organizer
items.why: A 49-inch hanging panel with seven mesh pockets and two clear zip bags that unclip for show days. Schneiders suggests hanging it by the grooming area as part of keeping the tack trunk from overflowing.

items.name: Windsor Helmet with MIPS
items.why: A matte schooling helmet with a MIPS liner, six vents, a five-point adjustable harness and a removable, washable liner. It is certified to ASTM F1163-15 (SEI).

items.name: EQx Kylo Helmet with MIPS
items.why: A slim, UK-made Charles Owen helmet with MIPS, all-round venting and a washable headband. It carries three standards (ASTM F1163-15, PAS015 and VG1), and some sizes are backordered into January.
